test_title: PYST 3: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 31 July, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following combinations correctly matches the vitamin with its function and deficiency disorder?

options.text: Vitamin A - Promotes calcium absorption - Deficiency causes Scurvy
Vitamin D - Regulates vision pigments - Deficiency leads to Pellagra
Vitamin B₁₂-Aids nerve function and red blood cell formation - Deficiency causes Pernicious anaemia
Vitamin C - Supports blood clotting - Deficiency leads to Night blindness

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin B12 - Aids nerve function and red blood cell formation - Deficiency causes Pernicious anaemia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vitamin B12** is an essential nutrient primarily involved in **nerve function** and the **formation of red blood cells.** It plays a crucial role in maintaining the health of the nervous system and supports DNA synthesis.
 
• A deficiency of **Vitamin B12** can lead to a condition known as **Pernicious anaemia.** This disorder occurs due to the inability of the body to absorb Vitamin B12 efficiently, leading to decreased red blood cell production and neurological symptoms.
 
• Other symptoms of Vitamin B12 deficiency include fatigue, weakness, memory issues, and numbness or tingling sensations</stron
